page.layout: One title page: centred title block at top; below it two parallel columns of contents (left column I and II, right column III to V); below them a centred edition line and motto; then a woodcut with its motto in the centre; then the imprint at the foot. Stamps and an armorial device on the left are not printed text.

l.i: CYPRIANVS: Si ad Divinæ Traditionis caput & originem revertamur, cessabit Error humanus.

page.notes: The woodcut shows two seated female figures flanking a wreath-framed cartouche reading "QVOD TIBI FIERI NON VIS ALTERI NE FECERIS". The oval library stamp "BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE ROMA" and the armorial device on the left are not transcribed. Several lines of the contents columns are set in small capitals and were transcribed in mixed case where the scan is clear; the column layout is reproduced as lines. The lowest line of the Cyprian motto and the printer's line are small and partly worn.
